scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,admin -c red,green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:5005/health && npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5005/health && npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install && cd ../admin && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.render:build: npm run install:all && npm run build
